model_system: PT-symmetric collinear antiferromagnet orthorhombic CuMnAs with Néel vector along [001]

key_params.observable: second-order nonlinear magnetic orbital Hall conductivity / collinearly polarized orbital current
key_params.comparison_component: chi_zzyy^(S) for nonlinear magnetic spin Hall effect
key_params.chemical_potential_scan: around E_F, plotted from about -0.1 to 0.1 eV
key_params.k-space focus: Fermi-surface contribution near the nodal-line-derived region around X in the k_y=0 plane
key_params.SOC_role: required; weak SOC slightly gaps nodal lines and strongly enhances orbital response

headline_claim: In CuMnAs, the nonlinear magnetic orbital Hall response reaches about -0.04 (h/e) Ohm^-1 V^-1 for chi_zzyy and is about two orders of magnitude larger than the nonlinear magnetic spin Hall response near the Fermi level.
replication_difficulty: high - requires SOC DFT, Wannier interpolation, and second-order Berry-curvature-dipole evaluation on dense k meshes in an antiferromagnetic state.
